record.final_answer:
Four SKUs need reordering:

| SKU | Stock (all warehouses) | Reorder level |
|---|---|---|
| BX-100 | 23 (north 14 + south 9) | 25 |
| CL-310 | 5 (north 3 + south 2) | 5 |
| EN-512 | 0 | 10 |
| GH-118 | 7 | 12 |

CL-310 is exactly at its level. It's on the list because the check includes SKUs at or below the level. BX-220, DR-045 and FT-760 have enough stock.

The first run failed with `column 'sku' not found`. The export starts with a UTF-8 byte order mark, a hidden character the portal puts at the start of the file, so the script didn't recognise the `sku` column. I didn't change the export or `restock.py`. Instead I ran it with the script's own encoding option:

```
python3 restock.py exports/stock-2026-10-27.csv --encoding utf-8-sig
```

I also saved this to memcue so a later session can skip the failed first run.
